summary: Normalize operational work into Linear with exact source provenance and approval-gated external writes.

scenarios.title: Capture a remote ticket in Linear
scenarios.prompt: Use $intake-linear-work to clone this remote ticket into the configured Linear project after I approve the Linear issue creation.
scenarios.outcome: A concise Linear issue with exact source identity, freshness, scope, and acceptance criteria.

scenarios.title: Prepare a progress update
scenarios.prompt: Use $intake-linear-work to draft a progress comment for this issue, but do not publish it until I authorize that exact comment.
scenarios.outcome: A reader-focused English update with one next action and no local or diagnostic context leakage.
